title: Maximum Unique Subarray Sum After Deletion
summary: Given an integer array, you can remove any elements to form a non-empty array.
statement: Given an integer array, you can remove any elements to form a non-empty array. Then, choose a subarray with unique elements to maximize the sum. Return the highest possible sum of this subarray.
constraints: Delete any elements while keeping the remaining order, but keep at least one.
Choose the retained array so its values are distinct and its sum is maximal.
hints: Each distinct positive value can improve the sum and should be kept once.
Duplicates add no new allowed value, while negative values reduce the sum.
If any positive exists, sum the set of positives.
Otherwise the nonempty requirement makes the largest single value optimal.
editorial: Otherwise the nonempty requirement makes the largest single value optimal.

tests.explanation: Keeping every distinct positive value gives sum fifteen.
Keep one occurrence of one; adding zero does not improve the sum.
